_comment: Bean k59d, 2026-09-21. The stale paths the check found on the day it shipped, all in GOAL milestones belonging to other sessions. k59d did NOT edit them -- a milestone is a statement of what its owner believes the goal needs next, and rewriting somebody else's belief is not a CHECKER's to do. That ground still holds for a checker: a gate that guesses replaces a stale belief with an invented one. The owner ruled 2026-09-22 that the SESSION owning a milestone's work may repair it, having re-measured the surface (skills/folio-core/coordinate.md, 'Crossing into a sibling's subject'). Both entries are gone by that route: p5wm:chain removed by stream 10uc (#960), yg29:numbered-step by stream w0cr (#961). AN EMPTY `known` IS THIS FILE'S SUCCESS STATE, NOT ITS FAILURE STATE -- the file exists to shrink rather than fossilise, and empty exempts nothing, so a NEW stale path still fails. That the two removals collided is recorded rather than smoothed over: each PR removed its own entry and kept the other's, so whichever merged second had to resolve to [] rather than to either side; taking one side would have re-asserted a baseline entry for an already-repaired milestone. Same rule as bean-bodies-baseline.json. Add an entry only for a milestone whose repair belongs to somebody who is not here. 2026-09-25, bean k59d round 2: the `done-when` rule was added -- an UNCHECKED `- [ ]` clause naming a closed bean in a PRECONDITION position ("once `x` is settled", "`x` fixed"). It found three on arrival, in two beans belonging to other sessions, so they are baselined here on the same ground as the originals rather than edited. `b5f0` is the one worth a reader's attention: it waits on "`7u3g` fixed", and `7u3g` is SCRAPPED -- a box that can never tick, which is precisely the abandoned-work shape bean-blocking describes. Measured: 16 unchecked clauses name a closed bean; 3 assert one as a precondition; the other 13 act ON a finished bean ("`1hvo` and `7u3g` are re-read under that distinction"), which is correct prose and is not reported.
